title: Encoded path edge relation
statement: For a Boolean sequence $x$, a natural number $n$, and vertices $u,v$ among the $n$ positions, define $u$ and $v$ to be related by an edge exactly when they satisfy the edge predicate determined by $x$ and $n$.
caveat: The definition of the underlying edge predicate is not included, so its meaning cannot be specified more concretely.
